mapper.sql: id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, scope_tenant_id AS tenant_id, payload_json, status, retry_count, max_retries, last_error, next_retry_at, processed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plat_outbox_event (event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, scope_tenant_id, payload_json, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{tenantId}, #{json}, 'PENDING', 0, 5, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plat_outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= NOW() ORDER BY id LIMIT 30
SELECT FROM plat_outbox_event ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE plat_outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', processed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plat_outbox_event SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetry}, last_error = #{error}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plat_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER')
